title: VERITYGATE: A Four-Gate Schema-Level Faithfulness Framework and Paired Benchmark for Grounded LLM Narrations over Structured Evidence
abstract: arXiv:2610.00833v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Fluent LLM explanations may not follow the evidence from a structured system. We present VERITYGATE, a four-gate checker for declared evidence IDs, entities, numbers, and claim types. It checks a fixed schema; it does not verify every fact in the prose. At r=0 and r=1, we test 900 instances per setting (450 grounded-ungrounded pairs) with GPT-4o-mini, Llama-3.3-70B, and Claude Sonnet 4.6. Under this schema-level contract and before repair, 80.3% of mini claims and 47.9% of Sonnet claims fail. These are verifier rejection rates, not prose-hallucination rates. One repair pass raises claim survival from 19.7% to 28.0% for mini and from 52.1% to 54.3% for Sonnet. Verified claims per example change by +0.14 for mini, -0.71 for Llama, and -0.47 for Sonnet, so survival and output volume must be reported together. A second Sonnet pass gives no clear gain. At r=1, Gate 4 covers 97.0%, 98.7%, and 100% of failing claims for mini, Llama, and Sonne

translated_title: VERITYGATE：一个基于结构化证据的有据LLM叙述的四道门卡模式级忠实性框架与配对基准
translated_abstract: 流畅的LLM解释可能并未遵循来自结构化系统的证据。我们提出VERITYGATE，一个针对所声明证据ID、实体、数字和声明类型的四道门卡检查器。它检查固定的模式；它并不验证文本中的每个事实。在r=0和r=1设置下，我们使用GPT-4o-mini、Llama-3.3-70B和Claude Sonnet 4.6测试了每种设置900个实例（450个有据-无据配对）。在这一模式级契约下、修复之前，mini的声明有80.3%失败，Sonnet的声明有47.9%失败。这些是验证器拒绝率，而非文本幻觉率。一次修复使mini的声明存活率从19.7%提升到28.0%，Sonnet的从52.1%提升到54.3%。每个示例的已验证声明数变化为mini +0.14、Llama -0.71、Sonnet -0.47，因此存活率与输出量必须一并报告。Sonnet的第二轮修复没有明显收益。在r=1时，门卡4覆盖了mini、Llama和Sonnet失败声明的97.0%、98.7%和100%。
tldr: 提出了VERITYGATE四道门卡模式级忠实性检查框架与配对基准，用于检验LLM对结构化证据叙述的忠实性，并揭示修复带来的声明存活率提升必须与验证声明输出量的变化联合报告。
en_tdlr: VERITYGATE is a four-gate schema-level faithfulness framework and paired benchmark for evaluating LLM narrations over structured evidence, showing that repair-induced claim survival gains must be jointly reported with changes in verified output volume.
